t.OCTOCRYLENE.agn: In the EU the limit is 9% in sprays and 10% in other products (EU 2022/1176, Annex VI entry 10); benzophenone as an impurity must be kept at trace level. It is on the EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (group A); the SCCS found it safe within these limits.
t.OCTOCRYLENE.eff.0: Put on the EU priority list over a suspected effect on the hormone system; the SCCS found it safe within the regulatory limits.
t.OCTOCRYLENE.k3.0: EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (group A). SCCS 2021: found to be safe within a limit (a maximum of 9% in sprays).
t.OCTOCRYLENE.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex VI, entry 10: Permitted UV filter, with an upper limit.
t.OCTOCRYLENE.summary: A common UV filter in sunscreens.
t.OCTOCRYLENE.what: Absorbs UVB and short-wave UVA rays; protects other filters from breaking down in light.
